observations: Single photo shows an orange/yellow manual pallet jack with two forks and wheels, parked on a tiled balcony/patio.
Background shows unrelated items (wheelchair, bags, railing) suggesting a personal/outdoor storage location rather than a warehouse.
A faint number (possibly '260' or similar) appears on a sticker on one fork, but it is not clearly legible.
Watermark text 'PREYE DOUGLAS77' overlays the image, likely a reseller tag, not a brand name.
No capacity plate, serial number, or manufacturer logo is clearly readable.

claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: No capacity plate or rating is clearly legible in photo 0; the only visible sticker number is blurred/illegible.

claims.claim: Upgrade your warehouse, supermarket, or logistics...
claims.evidence: Marketing language, not a checkable fact from the photo.

risks.risk: Actual load capacity may be lower than stated 2.5 Ton
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the capacity/rating plate on the jack body
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lower-capacity (e.g. 1-2 ton) or unverified-capacity unit

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may be worn, leaking, or not lifting properly
risks.proof: Video clip showing the handle being pumped and forks visibly rising under a load
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing repair

risks.risk: Wheels (steering and load rollers) may be cracked or flat-spotted from wear
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all wheels from underneath

risks.risk: Frame or forks may have rust, cracks, or prior welding repairs hidden by paint
risks.proof: Photos from multiple angles including underside and weld points
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic paint hides structural wear

risks.risk: Fork width/length may not match buyer's pallet standard
risks.proof: Measurement photo with tape measure against forks
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard-size unverified, no premium for compatibility

proof_requests: Video showing the pump handle being operated and forks lifting a visible load
Clear photo of the capacity/rating plate or stamped tonnage marking
Close-up photos of all four wheels and fork undersides
Photo with a tape measure showing fork length and spacing
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a manual hydraulic pallet jack, but its stated 2.5 Ton capacity and working condition are unverified from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified capacity, unproven function) against the only comparable listing available.
